tools.name: context_metadata
tools.description: Return the record count of a context handle, without its records.

tools.name: context_query
tools.description: Return records {line, text} from a context handle: at most limit records (1-64, default 20) starting at offset (default 0). select keeps only the named fields.

tools.name: repl_eval
tools.description: Evaluate Clojure in this session's SCI worker and return its value: a string as plain text, any other value as EDN. Definitions persist across calls in the same session. Send one or more forms; they run in order and the last value is the result. A def shows its var name, so definitions need no trailing nil. The value of every result is also bound to last-result. Helpers: (parse-long s) returns an integer or nil; context-lines is the context as a vector of lines; (page v offset n) returns n characters of v's printed text from offset. A result larger than about 60 KB comes back as a preview with a truncation note, and the worker keeps running. Its full value is bound to full-result, which paging does not change; read the rest with (page full-result offset n). Clojure reader syntax works: #"\d+" (no double escaping), #(...), 'x, @x and #'v. #= and tagged literals such as #inst are refused. clojure.string and String methods such as (.indexOf s "x") work, as does Integer/parseInt; Long, Math and Character classes do not. read-string, eval, slurp, spit and printing (println, pr-str) are denied; build text with str and clojure.string.

tools.name: agent_call
tools.description: Run a child session, or resume a completed one by its id, on a subtask with selected evidence. The child has its own SCI worker and the same context. Returns its done summary.

tools.name: done
tools.description: Finish this session with exactly one of: summary, the result as text; or source, Clojure forms evaluated in this session's SCI worker (same rules as repl_eval) whose last value, a string, is the result. For the root session the result is the exact final answer. For a long answer, build it in SCI and pass source instead of typing it.

tools.name: artifact_inspect
tools.description: Read an approved artifact's verified source and invocation contract without executing it. Use a hash from approved-functions. section is function (default) or applicability. offset defaults to 0; limit defaults to 4096 characters. Follow next-offset to read more. An approved artifact refused on this task is inspectable but not callable. Past validation and predicate success do not guarantee current applicability.

tools.name: artifact_call
tools.description: Invoke an admitted approved artifact by its hash from artifact_inspect, with an arguments array matching its arity and source contract. Runs the verified artifact and its dependencies in a fresh isolated worker with the same helpers and external-context binding as repl_eval; returns its result with provenance. Arguments are JSON data, never source code. For computation over external-context, the same admitted function is also callable by its listed name in repl_eval. Inspection and copying source do not count as invocation.

tools.name: done

tools.name: artifact_inspect
